entries.note: An unnamed wajh (the reading's sharʿ side, which al-Inṣāf reports as the jumhūr's) against Abū Bakr's choice, which the Muntahā and the Iqnāʿ state for the vowed udhiya.

evidence.excerpt_ar: أصح الوجهين. لكن جمهور الأصحاب على خلاف ذلك.
evidence.note: After reporting Abū Bakr's, al-Qāḍī's and al-Muwaffaq's permission to eat from the vowed udhiya: the jumhūr of the aṣḥāb hold otherwise (no eating).

evidence.excerpt_ar: صدقة بثمنها وسن أن يأكل منها ويهدي ويتصدق أثلاثا حتى من واجبة ولكافر من
evidence.note: On the udhiya, which «وتجب بنذر»: eating a third is sunna even from an obligatory one.

evidence.excerpt_ar: كان تطوعا والصدقة بثلثها ولو كانت منذورة أو معينة ويستحب أن يتصدق
evidence.note: On the udhiya: the sunna of eating, gifting and giving a third holds even if it is vowed or designated.

naskh.note: On fasting the days of tashrīq for an obligation, al-Inṣāf reports al-Zarkashī: «وهي التي ذهب إليها أحمد أخيرا» of the riwāya barring it, a reported chronology. al-Inṣāf (v11:p124) ties the vowed fast to that question, so the later riwāya covers it: naskh by the bank's rule (a later riwāya with reported chronology), ahead of tarjīḥ. The outcome is unchanged (against the reading).

entries.note: An unnamed wajh (the reading's sharʿ side, resting on Aḥmad's riwāya permitting the vowed fast in tashrīq) against Ibn ʿAqīl's «كنذر المعصية», which the Muntahā and the Iqnāʿ state; Aḥmad's other riwāya, barring any farḍ fast in tashrīq, is reported by al-Zarkashī as his last. Register sweep: resolved by naskh (al-Zarkashī's chronology), not tarjīḥ.

evidence.excerpt_ar: أحمد أجاز صوم النذر في أيام التشريق، على إحدى الروايتين، مع تأكد الصوم.
evidence.who: Aḥmad's riwāya, cited by al-Qāḍī (al-Khilāf) in al-Inṣāf
evidence.note: al-Qāḍī's ground for performing a vowed prayer in a time of prohibition: Aḥmad permitted the vowed fast in the days of tashrīq, on one of two riwāyas.

evidence.excerpt_ar: وابن رزين في شرحه. قال الزركشي: وهي التي ذهب إليها أحمد أخيرا، وجزم به
evidence.who: Aḥmad's riwāya, reported by al-Zarkashī in al-Inṣāf
evidence.note: On fasting the days of tashrīq for a farḍ: the riwāya «لا يجوز» is the one Aḥmad went to last; al-Inṣāf (v11:p124) makes the vow of them a vow of the ʿīd fast on that riwāya.

evidence.excerpt_ar: كشرب خمر وصوم يوم عيد أو حيض أو أيام التشريق فيحرم الوفاء به ويكفر من لم
evidence.note: The vow of sin, among whose examples the fast of the days of tashrīq: its fulfilment is forbidden and he expiates.

evidence.excerpt_ar: وأيام التشريق فلا يجوز الوفاء به ويقضى الصوم ويكفر فإن وفى به أثم ولا
evidence.note: The vow of sin, among whose examples the days of tashrīq: it may not be fulfilled; the fast is made up and he expiates.

entries.note: A riwāya of Aḥmad (the reading, under the attached qāʿida) against al-Khiraqī's jazm, which al-Inṣāf makes the madhhab and the Muntahā states.

evidence.excerpt_ar: قوله (وللثاني أن ينكحها بعد انقضاء العدتين) . هذا المذهب. جزم به في
evidence.note: The second husband who married her in her ʿidda may marry her after both ʿiddas: «هذا المذهب»; the riwāya of perpetual prohibition follows as «وعنه».

evidence.excerpt_ar: أن ينكحها بعد العدتين وتتعدد بتعدد واطئ بشبهة لا بزنا وكذا أمة في
evidence.note: Of the woman married in her ʿidda: «وللثاني أن ينكحها بعد العدتين».
